spec.name: qkd_kvs_pc_h_sr10b-sr10b-0f0fcb709-arg2
spec.purpose: KV-PC11 sr10b (parallel fallback of sr10): column B (CDC down 6 / up 5) in 4/4/3-bank groups with two 21.4 um channels and the tag queue moved to its own 2-bank stack at x 108.0 (MY): the sr10 gate showed column B as a 7-bank over a 6-bank stack with a 10.8 um gap, the same no-horizontal-crossing barrier (M5 cap) between the centre and the E-face logic that failed sr9 in column A.  KV-PC10 sr10 (route qkd_kvs_pc_h_sr9-sr9-596963735 NEEDS_RTL FF hold -57 / DRC 5): column A (front + return) in 3/2/3/2-bank groups with >= 21.5 um routing channels, tag queue abutted on the CDC up stack in column B: the sr9 5-bank stacks forced every horizontal wire (M5 cap: M2/M4 blocked over banks) to detour up to 45 um; the H-tree tap at x 39.4 fed capture leaves at x 80 over a 102 ps detoured net (70 ps skew between abutting flops -> FF hold -57 ps), and the shared return w_addr net shorted on M4 at the stacked bank pins (DRC 5).  RTL = r8 528d8460a.  KV-PC7 sr10b (SAFE successor of sr8 after gate *-20261020-054430: textbook REFUSE reset_landing 9 / 9 raw RESETN loads + logic_depth 895 / 942 ps; PRE-CTS reach 493 pairs > 405 um): (1) rst_n / hrst_n clear only two kept first-stage captures (the 8 second-stage copies clear from the second capture: 2 RESETN loads per port, release still 2 edges); (2) scheduler column decision restructured exactly (registered static-row match, no constant twin leaves, s_go in the last rd_ok / wr_ok gate, k1v / write-queue lookahead per case); (3) N-face order o_next | o_grp_h | pc__fo | i_next | ... so N <-> S feed-throughs run straight.  KV-PC4 sr10b (variant c, same RTL as sr6): column A banks (front / return / tag queue) mirrored (MY) in place (x=43.2) so their read faces (rd_out / addr / clocks: the W face in R0) look at the centre logic; gate pc_sr6 180008 overflowed GRT (1028: read words crossing column A through its stack gaps and ends; one failed route = structural redesign).  KV-PC3 sr6: (1) pc__fi / pc__ki / x__est__0_1 land in face registers (no S-face pin -> N-face output-clone cone, no kick-word or boot-ready input cone; +1 edge each, handed to the die schedule); (2) boundary_tcl re-applies the measured hck IO after every io_ref switch (the post-CTS io_ref_skew put the 419 hck-only inputs on core_clk: 505 fake CDC setup endpoints + ODB-0373 on the pc__pi[0] hold pad).  KV-PC2 10-19 (structurally safe successor of sr1 / sr2): KV-PC SAFE 10-19 (one failed route = structural redesign; terminal gate 1248d0585 PC WARN / PC_H FAIL): the five runtime-indexed flop arrays (front 32x297 = 9216 FF on 4 storage roots, tag queue 64x34, return ring 8x288, embedding CDC FIFOs 8x349 / 8x258) are 23 native 32x64 dual-clock SRAM banks (kv_pc_sram_gen / qkd_kvpc_sram_1019.sv; 0 added edges); the 2405 / 2051 / 854-load pointer roots are gone; scheduler hr_q / hgo are kept copy families split <= 32 loads (ot_rst_copies); front banks write AND read on hck (the landing / pointer clock: no storage-root clocks, no same-phase claim); return-ring banks write on hck, read on ck behind per-slot toggle 2-flop synchronisers; embedding FIFOs are Gray-pointer async FIFOs; the three dropped sticky faults (chain / es_merge / embr) leave registered on pc__hfx[2:0] for the health plane.
